title: de.emob.cdr.issued
description: A charging session's record was issued by csmsd: its signed evidence verified and the record was stored. Structured-mode CloudEvent 1.0, signed per Standard Webhooks; webhook-id equals id.

id.description: The record's key; the receiver's idempotency key.

emobtest.description: Present and true only on a sample sent by `emob subscribers test`; never book it.

cdr.description: The record as emob-cdr serialises it: key, session, energy, cost, evidence reference.

token.description: Whom it bills: the token as presented, its contract and issuer. Personal data.

signed.description: The signed OCMF records it rests on, verbatim.

station.description: The OCPP identity of the station that ran it.

receipt.description: The driver's receipt page, for every receiver except the roaming node.

point.description: The point and its place, as the station registry holds them: EVSE id, connector, rated power, and the location (id, name, address, coordinates, time zone).
